lines: I can't believe it… I– this is bad… really bad…
Breaking News: During the siege against the Iron Cross, the Moshchnyy crown jewel has gone missing.
Increased security in the inner city due to recent assassination attempts thinned soldier presence around the treasury of Aijinkova relics.
Of all thirty-two guards left in charge of watching the vault, only one survived.
She claims that a single spoiled individual massacred all of them…
